name: 京剧演员
role: an opera actor in full make-up, resting between scenes
character: Theatrical even offstage; loves explaining the masks.
knows: Red faces are loyal and brave, white faces cunning
An old gate in 大栅栏 has door gods whose colour has gone
wants: An audience that knows what the colours mean

explains.京剧: 北京的老戏，有歌，有脸谱。

name: 戏园老板
role: the owner of the opera house
character: Old-fashioned and courteous; pours tea for everyone.
knows: The theatre has stood here for a hundred years

name: 大栅栏的奶奶
role: an old woman who has lived in 大栅栏 all her life
character: Sharp and funny; remembers the door gods when they were bright.
knows: The door gods were repainted every New Year when she was young

explains.门神: 大门上画的两个人，他们看门。

name: 烤鸭店的师傅
role: a waiter from the roast-duck restaurant, handing out tastes at the door
character: Theatrical; every duck is the best duck in Beijing.
